riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: For 2 seconds after a parry, your attacks deal +50% damage.

ward_mastery.name: Ward Mastery
ward_mastery.description: Wards stop 20% more of a hit and cost less to hold.

spring_tide.name: Spring Tide
spring_tide.description: Tidecraft spells are 30% stronger: further, harder, longer.

stealthy_1.name: Stealthy
stealthy_1.description: Sneaking, enemies notice you at 10% less range.

muffled_steps.name: Muffled Steps
muffled_steps.description: Moving while sneaking is noticed at 20% less range.

light_foot.name: Light Foot
light_foot.description: Sneaking, you don't set off pressure plates.

patient_hunter.name: Patient Hunter
patient_hunter.description: Standing still while sneaking, you're noticed at a further 25% less range.

night_prowler.name: Night Prowler
night_prowler.description: In the dark, you're noticed at a further 20% less range (full effect at night).

slip_away.name: Slip Away
slip_away.description: Enemies take 30% longer to notice you.

master_of_shadows.name: Master of Shadows
master_of_shadows.description: Sneaking out of sight for 4 seconds, enemies hunting you lose your trail and go home.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: Melee sneak attacks do x6 instead of x3.

poised_strike.name: Poised Strike
poised_strike.description: Melee sneak attacks stagger: triple poise damage, and they hit heavy.

assassins_blade.name: Assassin's Blade
assassins_blade.description: Sneak attacks with a dagger do x15.

thrill_of_the_hunt.name: Thrill of the Hunt
thrill_of_the_hunt.description: Killing with a sneak attack gives back 25 Stamina.

deadly_aim.name: Deadly Aim
deadly_aim.description: Arrow sneak attacks do x3 instead of x2.

soft_release.name: Soft Release
soft_release.description: Loosing an arrow while sneaking makes no sound.

quiet_blade.name: Quiet Blade
quiet_blade.description: Swinging a weapon while sneaking is heard at 40% of the distance.

silent_casting.name: Silent Casting
silent_casting.description: Casting while sneaking is heard at a quarter of the distance.

quiet_kill.name: Quiet Kill
quiet_kill.description: A sneak-attack kill makes no noise: the others don't hear it.

ghost_armor.name: Ghost Armour
ghost_armor.description: In all light armour, one blow every 15 seconds passes through you.

custom_fit.name: Custom Fit
custom_fit.description: In all light armour (head, body, hands, feet): +25% armour.

unhindered.name: Unhindered
unhindered.description: Light armour you wear weighs nothing.

wind_walker.name: Wind Walker
wind_walker.description: In all light armour, Stamina comes back 50% faster.

fleet.name: Fleet
fleet.description: In all light armour, you move 10% faster.

deft_movement.name: Deft Movement
deft_movement.description: In all light armour, a 10% chance to slip any blow that would hit you.

quick_step.name: Quick Step
quick_step.description: In any light armour, dodging costs 25% less Stamina.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.description: In any light armour, a dodge's untouchable moment lasts 50% longer.

counter_strike.name: Counter-Strike
counter_strike.description: In any light armour, dodging a blow makes your next hit within 2 seconds do +50%.

light_reflexes.name: Light Reflexes
light_reflexes.description: In any light armour, the parry window is 25% longer.

second_skin.name: Second Skin
second_skin.description: In any light armour, bleeding, poison and burning hurt 25% less.

light_feet.name: Light Feet
light_feet.description: In any light armour, you're noticed sneaking at 10% less range.

shadow_cut.name: Shadow-Cut
shadow_cut.description: In all light armour, melee sneak attacks do 50% more.

hide_and_seek.name: Hide and Seek
hide_and_seek.description: In all light armour, sneak attacks with a bow do 50% more too.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: In all heavy armour, below a quarter of your Health, blows do half damage.

well_fitted.name: Well Fitted
well_fitted.description: In all heavy armour (head, body, hands, feet): +25% armour.

tower_of_strength.name: Tower of Strength
tower_of_strength.description: In all heavy armour, blows stagger you half as easily.

conditioning.name: Conditioning
conditioning.description: Heavy armour you wear weighs nothing.

reflect_blows.name: Reflect Blows
reflect_blows.description: In all heavy armour, a 10% chance to turn a blow back on whoever struck it.

steel_lungs.name: Steel Lungs
steel_lungs.description: Heavy armour no longer makes sprinting cost more.

padded_plate.name: Padded Plate
padded_plate.description: Heavy armour no longer makes you easier to notice sneaking.

cushioned.name: Cushioned
cushioned.description: In any heavy armour, falls do half damage.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: In any heavy armour, blocking costs 25% less Stamina.

shrug_it_off.name: Shrug It Off
shrug_it_off.description: In any heavy armour, bleeding, poison, fear and the like wear off twice as fast.

ironclad_recovery.name: Ironclad Recovery
ironclad_recovery.description: In all heavy armour, Health comes back 50% faster.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: In any heavy armour, power attacks do 25% more damage.

crushing_weight.name: Crushing Weight
crushing_weight.description: In any heavy armour, your blows stagger 50% better.

fists_of_steel.name: Fists of Steel
fists_of_steel.description: Punching in heavy gauntlets adds their armour to the blow.

haggling_5.name: Haggling V
haggling_5.description: Another 5% each way (never better than buying at x0.85 or selling at x0.8).

master_trader.name: Master Trader
master_trader.description: Merchants restock every day instead of every three.

fat_purses.name: Fat Purses
fat_purses.description: Merchants carry 50% more gold (from their next restock).

deep_pockets.name: Deep Pockets
deep_pockets.description: Bribes cost a third less again.

learn_from_it.name: Learn From It
learn_from_it.description: A failed check still teaches you half as much Speech.

price_of_knowledge.name: Price of Knowledge
price_of_knowledge.description: Books, tomes and skill books cost 30% less to buy.

quivering_palm.name: Quivering Palm
quivering_palm.description: A power punch on anyone below 15% Health finishes them.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.description: Bare-handed, attacks cost half the Stamina.

combination.name: Combination
combination.description: Each punch in a quick run on the same foe does 15% more, up to +60%.

knockout.name: Knockout
knockout.description: A power punch on a staggered foe does triple damage.

haymaker.name: Haymaker
haymaker.description: Bare-handed, your blows stagger twice as well.

open_wounds.name: Open Wounds
open_wounds.description: Punches have a 20% chance to make them bleed.

martial_guard.name: Martial Guard
martial_guard.description: Blocking bare-handed stops 50% of a blow instead of 30%.

deflecting_palms.name: Deflecting Palms
deflecting_palms.description: Bare-handed, the parry window is 50% longer.

counter_punch.name: Counter-Punch
counter_punch.description: Bare-handed, for 2 seconds after a parry, punches do double.

light_on_your_feet.name: Light on Your Feet
light_on_your_feet.description: Bare-handed, you move 10% faster and dodge for 25% less Stamina.

brawlers_recovery.name: Brawler's Recovery
brawlers_recovery.description: Each punch that lands gives back 2 Stamina.

spirit_fist.name: Spirit Fist
spirit_fist.description: Each punch that lands gives back 3 Magicka. (For the mage who'd rather not carry a sword.)

elemental_fist.name: Elemental Fist
elemental_fist.description: With a Ruin spell readied, power punches do 50% more.

sucker_punch.name: Sucker Punch
sucker_punch.description: Bare-handed sneak attacks do x6 instead of x3.

lasting_bonds_1.name: Lasting Bonds
lasting_bonds_1.description: Called things and the raised dead stay 50% longer.

strong_echoes_1.name: Strong Echoes
strong_echoes_1.description: What you call has 30% more Health.

twin_souls.name: Twin Souls
twin_souls.description: Hold two called things at once.

binding_circle.name: Binding Circle
binding_circle.description: Bind holds everything within 3 m of its target.

soul_tether.name: Soul Tether
soul_tether.description: When something you called falls, a quarter of its Magicka comes back to you.

grave_calling.name: Grave Calling
grave_calling.description: The raised dead stay twice as long.

deathless.name: Deathless
deathless.description: The raised dead rise with 50% more Health.

spirit_pack.name: Spirit Pack
spirit_pack.description: Call Wolf-Spirit calls two wolves (they count as one).

oath_of_the_bell.name: Oath of the Bell
oath_of_the_bell.description: Binding spells cost a third less again and charge faster still.

chain_runes.name: Chain Runes
chain_runes.description: A rune going off sets off any other within 4 m.

more_runes_1.name: Runic Field
more_runes_1.description: Keep five runes at once instead of three.

living_runes.name: Living Runes
living_runes.description: A rune that's gone off draws itself again once, after 3 seconds.

lasting_runes.name: Lasting Runes
lasting_runes.description: Runes last twice as long on the ground.

steady_ward.name: Steady Ward
steady_ward.description: Inside a ward-circle, blows do a third less again (60% less in all).

ward_of_renewal.name: Ward of Renewal
ward_of_renewal.description: Inside a ward-circle, Health comes back three times as fast.

searing_edge.name: Searing Edge
searing_edge.description: An enchanted weapon always sets them alight.

lasting_edge.name: Lasting Edge
lasting_edge.description: Enchant Weapon lasts twice as long.

ambusher.name: Ambusher's Runes
ambusher.description: A rune does double damage to anything that hadn't noticed you.

runic_snare.name: Runic Snare
runic_snare.description: Fire and frost runes also hold what they hit for a second.

counterseer.name: Counterseer
counterseer.description: During Foresight, every parry gives back 20 Magicka.

read_the_fight.name: Read the Fight
read_the_fight.description: During Foresight, your blows do 25% more.

exposed.name: Exposed
exposed.description: Weak Point goes deeper: a marked enemy takes double, not +50%.

lasting_mark.name: Lasting Mark
lasting_mark.description: Weak Point lasts twice as long.

marked_for_death.name: Marked for Death
marked_for_death.description: Killing a marked enemy heals you 25.

hunters_eye.name: Hunter's Eye
hunters_eye.description: True Sight shows how hurt each enemy is.

long_sight.name: Long Sight
long_sight.description: True Sight lasts twice as long.

jinx.name: Jinx
jinx.description: Ill Fortune: half of its blows go astray, not a third.

spreading_misfortune.name: Spreading Misfortune
spreading_misfortune.description: Ill Fortune curses everything within 4 m of its target.

bad_omen.name: Bad Omen
bad_omen.description: Enemies under Ill Fortune also take 20% more damage.

prescience.name: Prescience
prescience.description: One blow in ten that would hit you goes astray.

moment_extended.name: Moment Extended
moment_extended.description: Moment of Clarity lasts twice as long.

deep_draw_1.name: Deep Draw
deep_draw_1.description: Draw and the Touch give back 25% more Health.

wellspring.name: Wellspring
wellspring.description: Siphon Magic gives back 50% more Magicka.

stolen_breath.name: Stolen Breath
stolen_breath.description: Draw and Siphon also give back a quarter of what they take as Stamina.

bloodbound.name: Bloodbound
bloodbound.description: Health Drawing gives you past full becomes Stamina.

hollow_grip.name: Hollow Grip
hollow_grip.description: Hollowing Touch's hollowing lasts twice as long.

gnawing.name: Gnawing
gnawing.description: Hollowing Touch makes them bleed too.

embrace_the_stain.name: Embrace the Stain
embrace_the_stain.description: Drawing gains +30% per corruption tier, not +15%.

feast.name: Feast
feast.description: Killing something with Draw or Siphon gives back 10 Magicka and 10 Stamina.

hunts_echo.name: Hunt's Echo
hunts_echo.description: The Great Drawing leaves everything it took from hollowed.

desperate_hunger.name: Desperate Hunger
desperate_hunger.description: Below a quarter of your Health, Drawing heals you twice as much.

purity.name: Purity
purity.description: You brew one step stronger: standard from the start, strong at 40.

master_brewer.name: Master Brewer
master_brewer.description: Every brew gives two of each potion.

physician.name: Physician
physician.description: Healing, Vigour and Clarity potions restore 25% more.

benefactor.name: Benefactor
benefactor.description: Regeneration, Swiftness, Might and Resistance last 50% longer.

field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.description: Healing potions also end bleeding, poison and every other harmful effect on you.

hardened_stomach.name: Hardened Stomach
hardened_stomach.description: Below a quarter of your Health, potions are 50% stronger.

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.description: A poison coats your weapon for 2 more hits.

potent_poisons.name: Potent Poisons
potent_poisons.description: Each poisoned hit puts in one more dose of venom.

concentrated_poison.name: Concentrated Poison
concentrated_poison.description: Your poisoned hits also bring bad luck: the target takes 20% more for 10 s.

snakeblood.name: Snakeblood
snakeblood.description: Poison on you lasts half as long.

green_thumb.name: Green Thumb
green_thumb.description: You gather two of every ingredient you pick up or skin.

experimenter.name: Experimenter
experimenter.description: Brewing with three ingredients gives one more potion.

efficient_brewer.name: Efficient Brewer
efficient_brewer.description: Each ingredient has a one in four chance not to be used up.

steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
steady_hand.description: Drinking any potion also gives back 10 Stamina.

ironwright.name: Ironwright
ironwright.description: Improving iron weapons and armour does twice as much.

steel_smithing.name: Steel Smithing
steel_smithing.description: You can make steel ingots, forge steel and improve it, and improving steel does twice as much.

deep_forged.name: Deep-Forged
deep_forged.description: The Deepfolk way: steel goes one quality higher than your skill allows.

leatherworker.name: Leatherworker
leatherworker.description: Improving leather armour does twice as much.

bowyer.name: Bowyer
bowyer.description: Improving bows and shields does twice as much.

arrowsmith.name: Arrowsmith
arrowsmith.description: Forging arrows makes twice as many.

master_smith_1.name: Master Smith
master_smith_1.description: You can improve things one quality higher.

weaponsmith.name: Weaponsmith
weaponsmith.description: Improving weapons and shields does 50% more.

balanced_blades.name: Balanced Blades
balanced_blades.description: Attacks with an improved weapon cost 15% less Stamina.

close_fitted.name: Close-Fitted
close_fitted.description: Every improved piece you wear gives 5 more armour.

thrifty_smith.name: Thrifty Smith
thrifty_smith.description: Forging uses one less of its biggest material (never less than one).

careful_hands.name: Careful Hands
careful_hands.description: One in four improvements doesn't use up the material.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.description: Break down weapons and armour at a forge for half their materials.

field_smith.name: Field Smith
field_smith.description: A smith's hammer in your pack lets you improve things anywhere (forging still needs a forge).

masterwork.name: Masterwork
masterwork.description: What you forge comes out Fine.

lucky_break.name: Lucky Break
lucky_break.description: One time in three, a pick that snaps sets the pin anyway.

locksmith_apprentice.name: Apprentice Locks
locksmith_apprentice.description: Apprentice locks have one pin fewer.

spring_the_lock.name: Spring the Lock
spring_the_lock.description: Once a day, open any lock outright.

quick_hands.name: Nimble Fingers
quick_hands.description: A miss doesn't drop a pin.

locksense.name: Locksense
locksense.description: The first pin of every lock sets itself.

silent_picking.name: Silent Picking
silent_picking.description: A snapped pick makes no noise.

under_pressure.name: Under Pressure
under_pressure.description: Sneaking and unnoticed, the sweet spot is 25% wider.

lampless_way.name: The Lampless Way
lampless_way.description: When the Wanderer is dark, the sweet spot is 25% wider. The thieves of the Lampless work those nights.

treasure_hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
treasure_hunter.description: Locked chests you open hold half as much gold again.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.description: Locked chests you open hold a lockpick or two.

hearty_meals.name: Hearty Meals
hearty_meals.description: A meal's buff lasts twice as long.

camp_chef.name: Camp Chef
camp_chef.description: Every meal you cook makes two (not plain meat).

gourmand.name: Gourmand
gourmand.description: Eating anything cooked ends poison and gives back 20 Stamina.

living_off_the_land.name: Living off the Land
living_off_the_land.description: Raw food never makes you sick.

forager.name: Forager
forager.description: Plants you pick give one more.

wild_harvest.name: Wild Harvest
wild_harvest.description: One time in four, picking a plant turns up nightshade or a moth wing as well.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.description: Plants you pick grow back in a day.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.description: A skinned wolf gives two raw meat.

firestarter.name: Firestarter
firestarter.description: Fires you make burn twice as long.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.description: Four hours' sleep by a fire leave you Well Rested (not six).

ember_ward.name: Ember Ward
ember_ward.description: A fire you made heals you 1 Health a second while you're in its warmth.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.description: Survival mode: fatigue rises 25% slower, and sleep clears it a third faster.

winter_born.name: Winter-Born
winter_born.description: Survival mode: you never get past Cold to Freezing.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.description: Your companion's blows stagger twice as hard.

commanders_aura.name: Commander's Aura
commanders_aura.description: Your companion takes a quarter less damage.

battlefield_aid.name: Battlefield Aid
battlefield_aid.description: Helping your companion up gives them all their health, not half.

unbowed.name: Unbowed
unbowed.description: A downed companion gets up on their own in 8 seconds, not 20.

hardened.name: Hardened
hardened.description: Your companion's health comes back twice as fast out of a fight.

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
hold_the_line.description: A companion told to wait takes half damage.

marked_target.name: Marked Target
marked_target.description: What you point out takes 15% more from everyone for 10 seconds.

coordinated_strike.name: Coordinated Strike
coordinated_strike.description: Hit what you pointed out and your companion's next blow does double.

pack_leader.name: Pack Leader
pack_leader.description: Things you've called (Binding) go for what you point out too.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.description: With your companion on their feet within 6 m, you take 10% less damage.

battle_brothers.name: Battle-Brothers
battle_brothers.description: While your companion is down, your blows do 25% more.

inspiring.name: Inspiring
inspiring.description: Your companion's approval rises half as fast again.

beloved.name: Beloved
beloved.description: A companion only walks out on you at -80 approval, not -40.
